title: Ellie Chadwick Quits Love Island Days Before Final Amid Tumultuous Romance with Finley Maddock
text:
Ellie Chadwick has unexpectedly left the Love Island villa just days before the final, following ongoing relationship drama with Finley Maddock. Her departure comes after a week of emotional turmoil triggered by Finley's flirtation with new bombshell Elicia Bailey. Although recent episodes showed the couple reconnecting during a recoupling, insiders confirm Ellie has now quit the show, a decision that will air soon. This marks the third non-dumping exit this season, following George Knight's personal reasons departure and Gabriel Garland's removal after background check issues. The popular ITV series also faces backlash with 534 Ofcom complaints lodged over the past week, focusing on alleged 'women-hating' content across four episodes, including the controversial Movie Night and Casa Amor fallout.
Ellie Chadwick has quit Love Island after days of threatening to walk out of the villa over her tumultuous relationship with Finley Maddock . The Scottish villa favourite has left the ITV dating show just days before the final, according to insiders.
Her departure comes after a week of tears for the estate agent after her partner Fin had his head turned by bombshell Elicia Bailey. Tuesday night's episode saw the pair's on/off romance back on track after Finley cut off his flirtation with Elicia and Ellie chose him in the recoupling. Those scenes were filmed days ago with insiders now revealing that Ellie has since quit the villa.
A source said: 'This is one where the time difference between show action and real life really matters. Viewers have seen Ellie threatening to leave across recent episodes, so the news of her now quitting won't feel like a surprise,' the insider added to The Sun.
'But in real time, her and Fin reconnected at the recoupling a few days ago so her decision to now leave is a shock. Viewers will see the dramatic action play out in an episode soon.
' Love Island have been contacted by Daily Mail for comment. Ellie is the third person to leave the show this year not via a dumping. Days into the series George Knight left the villa for 'personal reasons'. George has insisted he quit the villa after learning that a member of his family had a health concern, but sources have since shared the real reason behind his departure.
It's claimed that while George's story about his family is true, he has used it to hide the fact that he was axed after receiving a formal warning for using 'unacceptable language' in the villa. George then learned of his family news at the same time, but there is no suggestion that ITV bosses attempted to cover up his behaviour.
Casa Amor bombshell Gabriel Garland was axed from the show after just a day when revelations about his past came to light, after it was not picked up in official background checks. Meanwhile Love Island has been hit with 534 Ofcom complaints over the past week. It was revealed on Monday that viewers of the ITV dating show have reported to the regulatory body about four episodes over the past week, following calls to complain over 'women-hating'.
In Ofcom's weekly report - in which any show garnering over 50 complaints is reported - Love Island dominated with four episodes, while the only other shows were The Saturday Five, with 586 complaints and Alex Armstrong Tonight, with 257. Movie Night received a whopping 197 complaints, as predicted by viewers who alleged that Jasmine Gaziza Müller became a 'target'.
Ringing in with 167 complaints was the boys' return from Casa Amor, which saw Angelista and Jasmine devastated by Simba Kudyiwa and Kavan Murphy's decisions. The episode featuring the now-legendary fight between Lola and Julia, in which the former told the latter about her flirtations with Sean, received 75 complaints
